Area between curves, square cross-section volume, and a washer setup about y=-2 (outer radius f+2, inner radius g+2) each require choosing the right rule. Part (d) requires equating derivatives and a calculator solve. The numbers are clean, the intersection is given, and the wording is unambiguous. No out-of-scope content (no shells, arc length, or BC material).
